a.aria-label: NCBIProtein:WP_000689844.1 — enables → MetaCyc:RXN0-6550; subject experimental construct: ATCC 25922 gene cloned into pET28; protein expressed in E. coli Rosetta(DE3) pLysS and purified by nickel chromatography. Main Methods establish this preparation; inaccessible supplementary primers do not establish tag orientation here.; Evidence PMID:31950558: ATCC 25922 mtnN, mtnK, mtnA and ald2 were cloned into pET28, expressed in Rosetta(DE3) pLysS and purified by nickel chromatography; primers are assigned to supplementary Table S3. ((//passage)[41]); ATCC 25922 MtnN/Pfs supports this reaction. The current RefSeq sequence exactly matches historical UniProt C3TPS2 version 128, UPI0000036BC8, and the translated D1792_RS20095 CDS on ATCC 25922 chromosome NZ_CP032085.1 (complement(4193872..4194570); 232 residues). The multispecies RefSeq label alone is not strain evidence. Native DR76 locus names and this D1792 assembly are kept distinct. ; Evidence: MetaCyc:ENZRXN-29282, MetaCyc:ENZRXN-29282, MetaCyc:ENZRXN-29282, MetaCyc:ENZRXN-29282, MetaCyc:MONOMER-21156, NCBIProtein:WP_000689844.1, PMID:31950558

a.aria-label: UniProtKB:Q2RXI0 — enables → MetaCyc:RXN-21315; subject experimental construct: Native protein commentary describes a His10-tagged MtnA construct expressed in E. coli. The activity frame separately assigns partially purified heterologous protein evidence to the 2020 citation.; Evidence MetaCyc:MONOMER-17870: The complete protein comment describes cloning mtnA as a His10 construct, expression in E. coli and in vitro assay, citing the 2012 and 2020 studies. (/ptools-xml/Protein[@frameid="MONOMER-17870"]/comment); R. rubrum ATCC 11170 MtnA supports this reaction. a.aria-label: UniProtKB:P0DTQ2 — enables → MetaCyc:RXN-21317; subject experimental construct: N-terminal His6-tagged protein encoded by HD73-20 genomic DNA, expressed in E. coli BL21 CodonPlus (DE3)-RIPL and purified by Ni affinity chromatography. Tag-free DrdA used for structural and metal-loading studies is a separate preparation.; Evidence PMID:30082730: Genes were amplified from HD73-20 (BGSC 4D22) genomic DNA; cloning generated N-terminal His6-tagged DrdK and DrdI. ((//body//p)[35]); Evidence PMID:30082730: The Bacillus constructs were expressed in E. coli BL21 CodonPlus (DE3)-RIPL and purified using nickel affinity chromatography. ((//body//p)[36]); B. thuringiensis HD73-20 DrdK supports this reaction. The current UniProt identity is strain HD73, whereas the assayed gene source and deletion host were HD73-20 (BGSC 4D22). The evidence establishes the downstream three-enzyme module, not all four events in Bacillus. ; Evidence: MetaCyc:ENZRXN-29537, MetaCyc:ENZRXN-29537, MetaCyc:ENZRXN-29537, MetaCyc:ENZRXN-29537, MetaCyc:ENZRXN-29537, MetaCyc:ENZRXN-29537, PMID:30082730
